body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes build and test failures caused by TypeScript compilation errors and test assertion mismatches. The changes restore the test suite to a passing state by aligning mock data formats, test assertions, and imports with actual component behavior.

**Changes:**
- Removed unused `vi` import causing TypeScript `noUnusedLocals` violation
- Fixed mock data format to match component data extraction logic (changed `{ value: data }` to plain arrays)
- Added missing plugin side-effect imports to ensure component registration in tests
- Corrected test assertions to match actual component output (i18n keys, gallery rendering)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.test.tsx` | Fixed mock data format from `{ value: mockData }` to `mockData` to match ObjectTimeline's data extraction logic |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/console-load-performance.test.tsx` | Removed unused `vi` import that violated TypeScript's `noUnusedLocals: true` compiler option |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewSwitching.test.tsx` | Fixed mock data format to return plain array instead of `{ value: ... }` wrapper |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/ObjectView.test.tsx` | Changed assertion to expect raw i18n key `'console.objectView.objectNotFound'` instead of translated string when no I18nProvider is present |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/ObjectGalleryIntegration.test.tsx` | Removed incorrect assertion for subtitle field text that ObjectGallery does not render |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/BrowserSimulation.test.tsx` | Added side-effect imports for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/plugin-report` to register components tested by ComponentRegistry.get() |
</details>
